langan_frost_wane.notes: No match in any crawled source: Godfrey Daniels 2025-26 (live and archived), the ArtsQuest/SteelStacks API, the Musikfest 2026 schedules (all days), the Musikfest 2025 schedules and A-Z list, or Live at the Falls. The only 'Frost' in the data is 'The Frost Duo', a Scranton jazz duo. The trio is active: Showpass lists a show at the Birdhouse Center for the Arts, 7 N Main St, Lambertville NJ, on 2026-10-23 with Na'Bodach (https://www.showpass.com/langanfrostwane/). That venue is outside this Lehigh/Easton crawl, and press from 2021 calls them Philadelphia-area.

notes: Coverage gaps: ArtsQuest's API only goes back to 2025-09-11, so Jan-Aug 2025 SteelStacks shows other than Musikfest are missing. Only 8 of 21 Musikfest 2025 daily schedules were recovered. Godfrey Daniels' archive depends on what Wayback captured. Phillipsburg (Shappell Park / Union Square concerts), One Centre Square (its site fails TLS), State Theatre, Wind Creek, the Allentown Fair and Hamilton St bars were not crawled in depth: no 2025-26 lineups were findable within budget, or the venues book only national acts. Easton bar coverage is a partial sample. Musikfest dates count separately for each day an act played (many acts play 2-3 days in one festival); same-day duplicate sets are collapsed. Dates on 2026-10-26 or later are scheduled, not yet played. Solo artists were excluded (e.g. Ted Donatelli, George Hrab, Pentley Holmes, Ella Bruch, Cass Noelle, Seth Witcher, John Gorka). For solo-plus-band names, only the band-billed dates are counted (Hannah Noel Band, Ava Hoffman Band, Stacy Gabel Band/Trio, Andrew Tirado Trio, Melody Cruz and The Keystones, Dina Hall Trio/Band). Also excluded: DJs, school and community ensembles, dance series (Ten Tiny Dances), Afrobeat Productions (a promoter), national headliners (Here Come the Mummies and others), and unclear acts (Danny's Caribbean Jam, Twelve String, Whiskey and Roses, Bren). Tribute and party bands are included as regional club-level bands. A few club-level national touring acts that meet the 2-date rule are included and flagged by home_base (Scythian, Adam Ezra Group, Igor and the Red Elvises, The Muckers, Professor Louie, Joy and the Wildfire, Goodnight Moonshine, Newberry & Verch, The Kennedys); drop them if they are too far afield. Links and images are mostly null: link lookups returned almost nothing for these small acts, and no Bandcamp or band-site og:image was verified, so none was added. Home bases come from the Musikfest schedule PDFs or venue blurbs. Musikfest 2025 source_url values point at the Wayback copies of the PDFs.
